# Hyperwear

> > Hyperwear is a fitness equipment company specializing in weighted vests (Hyper Vest ELITE, Pro, TAC), rucking gear (Hyper Ruck), and functional training equipment (SandBell, SteelBell, SoftBell) for strength training and weight loss.

Hyperwear offers innovative weighted vests with adjustable weights and CORDURA fabrics, sandbag systems for functional fitness, and cooling vests (Cool2Shape, CoolOver) for metabolism activation. The company serves home gym enthusiasts, commercial fitness facilities, and military personnel with HSA/FSA eligible products and GOVX military discounts.
